messages.en: Time flies! We've already been working here for a year!
Right? Feels like we only just started.
Want to go for a run in the park this evening? We'll take it slow.
Sure! I'm ready. See you at the entrance at six, okay?
I'm going to practise badminton at the hall this evening. Come along!
Sure! I've booked a court for six. Let's just practise for an hour.

collocations.en: compete in a pantun poetry contest

messages.en: We're playing against Amir's team at that hall tomorrow, right?
Yep, at nine. I've booked the court.
